data.source_title: Guidance for emergency departments: initial assessment
data.source_setting: NHS England emergency department guidance, England.
data.source_n: Not applicable; operational guidance, not a cohort.
data.quantity: Target process for non-pre-alerted ambulance handover
data.value: Complete handover following locally agreed processes within 15 minutes of arrival; pre-alerted patients needing a clinical team should be received immediately; hospital responsibility for clinical assessment/treatment begins when ambulance arrives at department.
data.unit: minutes from ED arrival; workflow requirement
data.source_evidence_basis: Official NHS England guidance distinguishes heralded ambulance patients from unheralded self-presenters, sets separate handover process expectations, and states responsibility transfer at arrival.
data.limitations: England operational guidance, not an observed compliance estimate; local pathways and regulatory context may differ. Does not define a US hospital’s identity/registration steps.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Model ambulance arrival, pre-alert, immediate clinical receipt versus standard handover, then destination; keep administrative registration from delaying clinical ownership. Use 15 minutes as policy reference only, not actual RWJ handover time.
